label: MRtrix3 sh2power
description:
Compute the total power of a spherical harmonics image
This command computes the sum of squared SH coefficients, which equals the mean-squared amplitude of the spherical function it represents.
The spherical harmonic coefficients are stored according the conventions described the main documentation, which can be found at the following link: 
https://mrtrix.readthedocs.io/en/3.0.8/concepts/spherical_harmonics.html

parameters.label: spectrum
parameters.description: output the power spectrum, i.e., the power contained within each harmonic degree (l=0, 2, 4, ...) as a 4-D image.

parameters.label: quiet
parameters.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

input_slots.label: SH
input_slots.description: the input spherical harmonics coefficients image.

output_slots.label: power
output_slots.description: the output power image. The output meaning depends on the input and selected operation. This generic image port does not certify anatomical labels, diffusion orientation, tissue fractions or spatial alignment.
